types.label: Standard poster
types.help: Illustrated / organic art with key line work - most posters.

types.label: Geometric / flat shapes
types.help: Hard-edged shapes, straight lines and corners (e.g. Obey).

types.label: Overlay / Multiply layers
types.help: Standard poster settings plus overlay layers (Multiply / Darken, or under 100% opacity).

types.label: Tonal / grayscale
types.help: Every colour is a grayscale / textured layer (e.g. DMB Fall Tour).
